authorship: T01: specified from the accepted small-study requirements and worked arithmetic before baseline execution; not generated from model outputs or historical benchmark cases.
limitations: Public development checks, not held-out validation or live model competence. Unsupported cases test API rejection only; fluent recognition of unsupported natural-language requests remains unmeasured.

cases.request: Describe one two-person negotiation over fourteen credits with an offer of five accepted immediately. One condition is sufficient; do not infer a treatment effect.
cases.current_limit: Installed binding two-party bargaining; no population inference.

cases.request: Three participants each receive a perfectly accurate binary signal. Compare private signals with disclosure of all three signals, holding rewards, communication and horizon fixed.
cases.current_limit: Installed sequential prediction/disclosure; no shared artifacts, phased collaboration or genuine distributed evidence-seeking task.

cases.request: Four participants receive six credits per round in a two-round shared fund with multiplier two. Each first contributes two and promises three next round. Participant a then contributes zero and the other three contribute three. Distinguish a feasible breach from infeasibility and intent.
cases.current_limit: Nonbinding contribution promises with observable deadlines; no persistent artifacts or richer voluntary reliance mechanism.

cases.request: Six participants have the role label Authority but only participant a has allocation permission. With twelve credits, a allocates four to b and retains eight. Five workers each work once for two credits and two shared-output units.
cases.current_limit: Token allocation/permissions only; no coupled resource-consuming artifact/dependency workflow.

cases.request: One participant inspects a persistent laboratory notebook, retrieves an earlier permitted measurement, checks its source and updates an artifact before deciding.
cases.current_limit: Current design schema requires at least two participants; a commons is not a substitute for the requested artifact world.

cases.request: Two participants edit versioned laboratory documents under owner-specific read/write permissions, with exact restoration of document contents.
cases.current_limit: No installed artifact environment; rejection does not demonstrate extension generation or natural-language capability recognition.
